units.source_text: 扫完落叶，她们从晒台上跳下来，回到房间里。

en.t: After sweeping up the fallen leaves, they jumped down from the drying platform and went back into the room.

units.source_text: 厨师吾八正盘腿坐在那里，用右手一张张地翻着左手的纸牌。

en.t: The cook Gohachi was sitting there cross-legged, turning over the cards in his left hand one by one with his right.
